title: Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: 1st Place Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2611.11464v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $\pi_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference parameters. Out of the box, it took the policy to 0.85 RDS on held-out seeds in two days (and it was still very far from convergence). The competition-specific part adds data that local exploration cannot find: generated demonstrations that reach the full reward, and recovery episodes that start from the policy's own failures. translated_title: 带在线推理调优的离线策略强化学习：CoRL 2026 RoboEval挑战赛第一名解决方案
translated_abstract: CoRL 2026 RoboEval挑战赛包含八个双臂操作任务，它不仅根据策略是否成功，还根据其完成任务的方式来排名：任务的每个阶段都要安全、高效地完成，并要求双臂协同配合，最终与人类演示进行对比评分。我的解决方案分为两部分。通用部分沿用自我在LeHome挑战赛中的方案，是对一个基于 $\pi_{0.5}$ 的策略进行离线策略强化学习，该策略同时充当自身的价值函数。它使用AWR和RECAP在精确官方分数的优势上进行训练，并在一个循环中使每次rollout同时也是对约20个推理参数的汤普森采样试验。开箱即用，该方案在两天内将策略在保留种子上的RDS提升至0.85（且距离收敛仍相去甚远）。针对比赛的部分则补充了局部探索无法发现的数据：能够获得满奖励的生成演示，以及从策略自身失败状态出发的恢复片段。所提交的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该方案将基于π0.5策略（自任价值函数）的离线策略强化学习与AWR/RECAP优势训练及对约20个推理参数的汤普森采样在线调优相结合，并补充满奖励生成演示与失败恢复数据，最终夺得CoRL 2026 RoboEval挑战赛第一名。
en_tdlr: By combining off-policy RL on a π0.5-based policy that serves as its own value function—with AWR/RECAP training on exact official score advantages and Thompson sampling over ~20 inference parameters during rollouts—together with competition-specific data of full-reward generated demonstrations and failure-recovery episodes, this solution won 1st place in the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge.
